decisions.reason: The aloe vera facial care line has a dedicated website page and several models, indicating strategic focus and likely early acceptance, so it is too soon to drop it.
The hyaluronic acid serum aligns with the natural skincare portfolio and, despite only being mentioned on the website, one year is not enough to judge its performance.
The facial cleansing milk is close to the firm's established offer and should remain on the market to build presence before any drop decision.
